findings.title_text: Clause 21(a) (viii) benefit or perquisite in breach of the recipient's rules: candidates listed for the CA, not reported
limits_text: 1 P&L debit line(s) match the words for this item (ICAI GN ch.33 para 33.23 (Explanation 3(ii) to s.37(1); CBDT Circular 5/2012; cross-check s.194R); the clause 21(a) candidate spec); a match is a candidate, never a conclusion, and nothing is left out for being small. The CA decides what, if anything, is reported; no clause 21(a) row is written.

Only lines on ledgers under Purchase Accounts, Direct Expenses or Indirect Expenses were searched. Keyword recall is not measured: a narration in Hindi, Hinglish or left blank is missed, and a penalty booked only in the GST cash ledger, netted in a party account, or on a credit-card statement is not in these books.
ask_client_text: Any benefit or perquisite whose acceptance breaches the recipient's conduct rules? Cross-check the s.194R list.
